Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

Given the following question and four candidate answers (A, B, C and D), choose the best answer.
Question: A student filled three beakers, each with 50 milliliters of liquid water. The student cooled Beaker 1 to form ice. The student heated Beaker 2 to form water vapor (gas). Beaker 3 remained at room temperature. What process takes place when liquid water changes to a vapor (gas)?
A. condensation
B. evaporation
C. freezing
D. melting
Respond with one of the four choices (A, B, C or D).
